facets.label: Outcome reason
facets.value: The application demonstrated a fundamental failure in conversational engagement. While it initially asked reasonable clarifying questions about tone and genre, it subsequently became non-responsive to direct follow-up inquiries regarding ending tone and accessibility features—both of which I explicitly identified as critical constraints. The repeated identical recommendation without addressing my stated concerns suggests either a technical malfunction or an inability to process multi-turn dialogue meaningfully. I terminated the interaction because the application was not functioning as a genuine recommendation partner. The initial recommendations themselves were not unreasonable given my preferences, but the application's inability to justify its suggestions or respond to accessibility and content boundary questions rendered it unusable for my purposes.
